text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It happened when I was having
lunch at a cafe with Epiphaneia—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the meal!
That was delicious, wasn't it, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I had a hunch just from looking at the shop's exterior,
and it totally hit the jackpot!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
The steak is cooked to absolute perfection!
And the truffle-infused sauce is simply exquisite!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
That had no business being that delicious
for an affordable lunch!
choice_data_list: I guess we can look forward to dessert too.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Of course! We're definitely allowed to have high hopes!
Now then, what should we go with—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Classic cakes, puddings, parfaits.
They're not bad, but I want something with a unique twist... Hmm?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Look at this! Look at this!
choice_data_list: A world sweets fair? Huh, sounds pretty good.
A world sweets fair? Oh, that sounds lovely!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"That's true, but that's not what I mean!
Look, they have Galette des Rois under French sweets!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
And there's a fève inside!
This bakery really knows what they're doing!
choice_data_list: A fève is, if I recall—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: A fève is a small ceramic figurine. They say whoever finds it inside the galette des rois is blessed with good luck for an entire year!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
A chance encounter with the shop. A satisfying meal.
And even a dessert with a lucky item inside.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"This fève was surely
fated to be mine!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's eat the Galette des Rois!
The "Voice of Destiny" tells me to do so as well!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
No need to worry.
We just have to keep eating until we get a winner!
choice_data_list: If we don't get lucky today, let's come again another time.
Alright, let's make sure we get it!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Eeeh!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"...No, wait. If that's the case, does that mean
I get to come to this shop with Trainer lots of times?"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Yeah. That sounds pretty fun too!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's just eat one piece today.
It's a contest between you and me to see who finds the fève, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With hearts pounding in anticipation,
the two of us savored the Galette des Rois.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I knew you'd say that,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Watch closely as I seize happiness with my own two hands!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, Epiphaneia ate quite a few slices until she finally found the fève. Yet, her smile held nothing but pure, unregretful joy.
